title: Enforce system user authority independently of request path
description: Stage3 critical authority path repair. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysUserController.cs:46-53 gates live authorization only on Request.Path.HasValue. ERP453 business routes can bypass live account/menu and guarded role assignment for empty-path or in-process contexts. Require the existing guards on every read/create/update/delete/batch/status/reset/role-assignment entry, independent of request path; preserve credential handling and existing role assignment restrictions. Preserve existing ERP business permissions, data scopes, transactions and numeric validation. Adapt legacy controller fixtures to genuine enabled identities and their existing menu grants in isolated test data only. No Request.Path/environment/blank-context/test-only switch, anonymous fallback, permission expansion, production access or schema change. Genuine SQL uses exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database, refusing existing or wrong targets before access; never drop/reset. Preserve full failing logs. Safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors and full unit suite, plus new authenticated real SQL tests are required; build is not whole phase acceptance.
